name: FDN340P
title: 20 V single P-channel logic-level trench MOSFET in SOT-23
summary: A single P-channel enhancement MOSFET on onsemi's POWERTRENCH process, rated -20 V drain to source and -2 A continuous, in a three-lead SOT-23 (case 527AG) with the standard SOT-23 pin order and about 30 % more power handling than the ordinary package. On-resistance is at most 70 mΩ with the gate at -4.5 V and 110 mΩ at -2.5 V, and total gate charge is 7.2 nC typical. Its uses are load switching, power management, battery charging and DC-DC conversion in portable equipment.

operation.text: The threshold lies between -0.4 V and -1.5 V (-0.8 V typical) at -250 µA and moves 3 mV/°C. On-resistance is specified at two gate drives: 70 mΩ max at -4.5 V and 110 mΩ max at -2.5 V; at a 125 °C junction the -4.5 V limit becomes 120 mΩ. The gate may be taken to ±8 V and leaks at most 100 nA there. Charging the gate to -4.5 V at -10 V and -3.5 A takes 7.2 nC typical, 10 nC max.

The current and power ratings belong to two board mountings with 2 oz copper: a 0.02 in² pad (Note 1a, 250 °C/W, 0.5 W, -2 A continuous) and the Note 1b pad (270 °C/W, 0.46 W). Junction to case is 75 °C/W, the case being the drain pins' solder joint. The safe operating area, single-pulse power and transient thermal curves are for the Note 1b mounting, and the transient response changes with board design.
The drain-source diode carries -0.42 A continuous at most, with a forward voltage of -0.7 V typical and -1.2 V max at that current.

The SuperSOT-23 (case 527AG) keeps the industry-standard SOT-23 pin-out and handles about 30 % more power than the standard package. It contains no lead, halogens or BFRs and meets RoHS. It is marked 340 with a date code M after it, and ships 3000 to a 7-inch reel on 8 mm tape.
